pip-compile.description: requirements.txt is the source of requirements.lock: pip-compile updates the pins there and regenerates the lock

pip_requirements.description: Off: it would update the same pins in requirements.txt a second time, without the lock

customManagers.description: The Python in the header of requirements.lock. Renovate runs pip-compile on the Python named there, so after a Python minor PR is merged the next lock file maintenance recompiles the lock on the new Python. The python-version datasource only lists releases Renovate can install

packageRules.description: Automerge digest, patch, pin and lock file maintenance updates (python base image digest, PyPI pins, the weekly requirements.lock refresh) once the Test workflow passes; the merge then cuts a patch release (auto-release.yml). platformAutomerge is off: GitHub auto-merge is disabled and main has no required checks, so GitHub could merge before CI finishes. Minor and major updates wait for a person
Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp, so the 3-day minimumReleaseAge would hold it forever. pip-compile cannot apply an age itself: the weekly refresh takes the newest releases

Docker Hub serves tag timestamps to anonymous clients only for the first 1000 tags. library/python has 4000+, so Renovate falls back to the registry tag list, which has no timestamps, and under the default timestamp-required every python digest update would wait forever. Apply the 3-day age only when a timestamp exists (renovatebot/renovate#46925)
No Python major updates: a new major is moved by hand

One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps the SHA + '# vX.Y.Z' comment current). Never automerge: new action code runs with packages: write, so a person reviews every bump. Placed after the automerge rule so this automerge: false wins

A Python minor moves both FROM tags, the setup-python python-version in CI and the requirements.lock header in one PR, which waits for a person. groupSingleUpdates keeps the 'Python version' title while the PR has only some of the files (each part waits for its own 3-day release age). Placed after the 'GitHub Actions' rule so this groupName wins; digest updates of the current tag stay separate and automerge
